post_meta.title: Bishop Pass late May
post_meta.text: Bishop Pass 5/28. Winter conditions above 10,600. Continuous deep snow from Saddlerock Lake, the final ramp is a proper snow climb right now, crampons ideally. South Fork Bishop Creek is under snow bridges most of the way, some are getting thin. Not a summer stroll yet, friends.

detail.text: Bishop Pass on the 16th. Forty years walking this range and this is a top three snow year. Continuous snow from Bishop Lake up, the ramp is soft by 9am. Took crampons but honestly spikes would do. Long Lake outlet is flowing hard but there is a good log.
